title: Staircase
description: Draw five solid gray bands stacked from bottom to top. The bottom band is black, the top band is white, and the three between step up evenly. Each band has a hard edge, with no smooth blending.
hintText: floor() snaps a number down to a whole number. Scale uv.y by the band count, floor it, then scale back down so the top band reaches 1.0.
